diagnosis: The current V32 bootstrap admits only exact two- or three-token core shapes. The first three tokens provide a noun/finite-verb/noun candidate core, but the five-token input has no independent resolution of the i dag tail. Later phrase/MWE/attachment stages report no temporal-tail attachment; the missing V32 core prevents predicate/clause production.
contract_to_prove: Identify the producer and authority for i as a preposition and for the i dag occurrence as a temporal adjunct or competing analysis, preserving candidate status.
Specify how a verified subject/predicate core may survive an unresolved tail without claiming that the whole sentence or tail is grammatically valid.
Test positive and negative longer-tail minimal pairs and rerun the same fourteen-case corpus before changing V32 or activating the target rule.
scope: Read-only Production diagnosis. No new SQL change, grant or application integration.
